title: Inbound pressure observations
description: Read-only, content-free pre-admission pressure aggregates as reported by `medre inspect pressure`. Rows carry window, source attribution, outcome, and counters; never payloads, sender identity, or transport-native content. The outcome vocabulary is closed: three admission-gate facts recorded by the runtime gate (rejected, timed_out, deferred) and three producer-side staging facts reported by adapters before any admission attempt (scheduled, overflow, cancelled_before_admission). No outcome claims durable admission.

observations.description: Aggregate rows ordered by window start (ascending); `limit` bounds the listing to the newest windows.

window_start.description: Epoch seconds at the start of the fixed 60-second aggregation window.

source.description: Adapter id the pressure is attributed to, or the anonymous-source sentinel.

outcome.description: Admission-gate fact (rejected, timed_out, deferred) or producer-side staging fact (scheduled, overflow, cancelled_before_admission).

first_seen_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the earliest observation aggregated into this row.

last_seen_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the latest observation aggregated into this row.

source_filter.description: Adapter id the listing was scoped to, or null for all sources.

outage_gaps.description: Global outage-gap accounting rows, irrespective of source_filter. Lost refusal facts are represented by refusals_discarded, not invented pressure observations.

refusals_retained.description: Gate refusal facts durably persisted during recovery, including successful prefixes of interrupted batches.

outage_gap_count.description: Count of listed global outage-gap rows (limited like observations).

outcome_totals.description: Derived rollup of the listed rows' counts per outcome, in the closed vocabulary order; outcomes absent from the listing are omitted. Derived over the returned window only — rows remain the durable evidence.
